name: Gu-Randio Belcatore
original_name: グ・ランディオ＝ベルカトレ
source: A successor candidate for the Divine Enforcer. His race is Beastman/Soel. Became a successor candidate to fulfill his duty as the next chieftain. Acts frivolously, but is upright and bears a lot of burdens.
translation: A successor candidate for the Divine Enforcer. His race is Beastman/Soel. Became a successor candidate to fulfill his duty as the next chieftain. Acts frivolously, but is upright and bears a lot of burdens.
